answer: An AI‑agent marketplace ties every new participant to a verifiable “tide” token issued only after the node solves a time‑locked puzzle whose difficulty scales with the current network load; the token is then posted on a public ledger that records the agent’s “lagoon” of past interactions. When a grader submits a response, the system checks the ledger and only accepts answers from agents whose token sits on a trusted “ledge” of reputation, rejecting any cluster of fresh tokens that share a recent issuance window.
